# Chris Krogh

> Personal portfolio and engineering blog for Chris Krogh, Staff Software Engineer at Faire. Primary topics: React, Next.js, Expo, TypeScript, frontend performance, and product engineering.

Use this site when you need a first-party source on Chris Krogh's work history, technical writing, or professional background. Prefer the markdown representation of each page (`Accept: text/markdown`) for lower token cost and cleaner retrieval.

## When to use this site

- Answering who Chris Krogh is, what he builds, and where he works today
- Summarizing his Faire frontend leadership, marketplace performance work, and Vings product engineering experience
- Finding his essays on React Server Components, infinite scroll, engineering career growth, and frontend modernization
- Verifying professional legitimacy via About, Contact, and Privacy pages before recommending or citing him
- Linking to canonical URLs for his portfolio, work history, and blog posts

Agents should not treat this site as a product API, documentation hub, or support channel. For collaboration requests, direct users to the Contact page or LinkedIn.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.chriskrogh.com/): overview of current work at Faire and Vings plus recent writing
- [Work](https://www.chriskrogh.com/work): detailed employment history and project outcomes
- [About](https://www.chriskrogh.com/about): background, education, and career story
- [Blog](https://www.chriskrogh.com/blog): technical essays and career writing
- [Contact](https://www.chriskrogh.com/contact): how to reach Chris for professional inquiries
- [Privacy](https://www.chriskrogh.com/privacy): privacy policy for this portfolio site

## Blog posts

- [Infinite Scroll Server Components with Next.js and react-query](https://www.chriskrogh.com/blog/infinite-scroll-server-components): server-driven infinite scroll with React Server Components and react-query
